priorities.title: Executive clarity in professional answers
priorities.why: Diego already sustains long professional explanations; the next gain is making high-value answers more concise and easier to follow.

priorities.why: Accuracy is less consistent than fluency during spontaneous production.

priorities.title: Active business-language reuse
priorities.why: Diego has a strong specialist vocabulary base; deliberate reuse can make retrieval more automatic in professional contexts.

grammarOverview.title: Grammar & Accuracy Overview
grammarOverview.summary: Diego's communicative ability is stronger than his grammatical consistency. The current work is precision without losing momentum.
focusPoints: Agreement: stabilize auxiliary and subject-verb agreement in spontaneous speech.
Prepositions: use compact, natural professional combinations such as at work.
Verb patterns: consolidate frequent gerund/infinitive structures and natural business collocations.

teacherFeedback.title: General Feedback
teacherFeedback.body: Communicative ability is stronger than consistency. Focus on precision without losing momentum.

teacherFeedback.title: Growth Priority
